messages:
maria: opening the deploy window now for runtime v2.3.1 + router v4.2.0 + console v1.8.0. goal: rolling canary then 20% over 45m. handshake check before unpin.
ops-shepherd: noted. rolling canary 5% start. @ryan any blockers on the router header-key rename?
ryan: router rename is safe server-side, but it changes the header key we use for cache sharding -> could cause KV thrash until runtime TTLs settle. recommend slow ramp and a console pin option.
alice: runtime change clears prefix cache on hot endpoints. we saw 2-3x p95 on staging for first 10m. small canary ok but avoid big ramp.
deploy-bot: action: start_canary wave_id=wf-2026-04-03-21
```
services: runtime:v2.3.1 router:v4.2.0 console:v1.8.0
canary: 5% us-east-1 -> infra checks passed
```
sre-oncall: monitoring: slight uptick in 5xx (0.8%) and p95 +220ms on canary. set alert: rollback if 5xx >=1% for 2m or p95 delta >400ms for 5m.
maria: confirm runbook rollback criteria so we all copy it to release notes?
ops-shepherd: runbook snippet - rollback triggers: (1) sustained 5xx >=1% for 2 continuous minutes, (2) p95 latency +400ms sustained over 5 minutes, (3) console tool-call errors >0.5% for 3 minutes -> auto-rollback.
ryan: proposal: pin console back to v1.7.9 globally while runtime/router continue warm. avoids any tool-call mismatch and reduces noise for oncall.
alice: +1, but v1.7.9 doesn't have the new telemetry flag we wanted. ops-shepherd can deploy-bot do a scoped pin (global) for 1 hour?
deploy-bot: executing pin...
```
deploy-bot> pin service=console version=1.7.9 scope=global ttl=3600 initiated_by=maria
result: success
```
sre-oncall: after pin, 5xx back to baseline on canary hosts. p95 trending down but still watching.
maria: decision: hold full ramp. keep runtime+router on slow ramp (5% -> 15% in 20m steps) with console pinned to 1.7.9 for 1h. update release notes: "console temporarily pinned to 1.7.9 to avoid telemetry/tool-call regressions; runtime/router incremental ramp; rollback policy per runbook."
ryan: add note for oncall to run cache-priming job at T+25m if p95 > baseline. I'll paste the job command to #eng-sre.
alice: prepping a tiny cache-priming task, will share command.
product-bot: CHANGELOG updated: CHANGELOG-REL-2026-04-03.md -> noted pinned console entry.
ops-shepherd: good. recording the partial pin in the release checklist and tagging docs team to update the rollout note.
maria: thanks all. holding ramp and will post next checkpoint at T+25m. :white_check_mark:
